build_min_cut_rematerialization_partitio: build a partitioner that splits a joint forward-backward FX graph using min-cut rematerialization to trade memory for computation
create_default_partition: create a default partitioner that extracts forward and backward FX graph modules from a joint AOT autograd graph
test_reordering_to_mimic_autograd_engine: test the graph reordering pass that reorders backward operations to mimic autograd engine behavior and reduce memory footprint
refactor_functionalize_rng_ops: refactor forward and backward modules to share RNG state between recomputed and backward random operations using functionalize wrappers
summarize_draw_graph: summarize an FX GraphModule by drawing it to a file in SVG or PNG format using the FxGraphDrawer utility
